rows.reason: The .some callback executes only when coverage.parsed >= coverage.files and the language's issues are non-empty (formal-comparison.ts:116-122). Codex's premise 'every failed/skipped file lowers parsed' holds for files whose language is typescript, but a readable file that matches the scan's SOURCE_EXTENSION (typescript-light-scan.ts:50,66) yet is absent from TYPESCRIPT_EXTENSIONS (architecture-language-provider.ts:84) - e.g. scripts/x.mjsx - is recorded as a scan skipped issue (typescript-light-scan.ts:417-421) while languageOfPath counts it under 'other', not typescript (capture.ts:323-327); capture pushes that scan issue into the typescript coverage anyway (capture.ts:390).
